fields.name: displayMode
fields.label: Display mode
fields.description: Choose the classic letter grid or a clean typeset phrase.

fields.name: theme
fields.label: Theme
fields.description: Pick a built-in color palette, or choose Custom to edit the individual colors below.

fields.name: backgroundGradient
fields.label: Background gradient
fields.description: Use the theme's gradient background. Turn off for a flat background color.

fields.name: showFlair
fields.label: Show flair
fields.description: Show the small analog clock and the optional exact digital time/date.

fields.name: clockDialLocation
fields.label: Small clock dial
fields.description: Choose where to show the small analog clock, or hide it.

fields.name: showDigital
fields.label: Show small digital time
fields.description: Adds a small exact time and date under the word clock.

wordClockPanel.name: Word clock panel
wordClockPanel.description: Responsive SVG word clock panel with no network dependencies.

sources.config.json:
{
  "name": "Word clock panel",
  "category": "data",
  "description": "Responsive SVG word clock panel with no network dependencies.",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "fields": [
    {
      "name": "timeInfo",
      "label": "Local time info",
      "type": "json",
      "required": true
    },
    {
      "name": "displayMode",
      "label": "Display mode",
      "type": "select",
      "options": [
        "grid",
        "typeset"
      ],
      "value": "grid"
    },
    {
      "name": "clockDialLocation",
      "label": "Small clock dial",
      "type": "select",
      "options": [
        "top-right",
        "top-left",
        "bottom-right",
        "bottom-left",
        "hidden"
      ],
      "value": "top-right"
    },
    {
      "name": "showFlair",
      "label": "Show flair",
      "type": "boolean",
      "value": "false"
    },
    {
      "name": "backgroundGradient",
      "label": "Background gradient",
      "type": "boolean",
      "value": "true"
    },
    {
      "name": "theme",
      "label": "Theme",
      "type": "select",
      "options": [
        "midnight",
        "aurora",
        "ember",
        "sage",
        "plum",
        "ocean",
        "sandstone",
        "rosewood",
        "mono",
        "white",
        "paper",
        "cobalt",
        "moss",
        "custom"
      ],
      "value": "midnight"
    },
    {
      "name": "startColor",
      "label": "Gradient start",
      "type": "color",
      "value": "#101826"
    },
    {
      "name": "endColor",
      "label": "Gradient end",
      "type": "color",
      "value": "#28485c"
    },
    {
      "name": "litColor",
      "label": "Lit word color",
      "type": "color",
      "value": "#fff4d6"
    },
    {
      "name": "dimColor",
      "label": "Dim letter color",
      "type": "color",
      "value": "#51677a"
    },
    {
      "name": "accentColor",
      "label": "Accent color",
      "type": "color",
      "value": "#d9a441"
    },
    {
      "name": "showDigital",
      "label": "Show small digital time",
      "type": "boolean",
      "value": "true"
    }
  ],
  "output": [
    {
      "name": "image",
      "type": "image"
    }
  ],
  "permissions": []
}
